## Statement · **draft**
Let $R$ be a principal ideal domain and $A \in M_{m \times n}(R)$. Then there exist invertible matrices $P \in \operatorname{GL}_{m}(R)$ and $Q \in \operatorname{GL}_{n}(R)$ such that

$P A Q = \operatorname{diag}(d_1, d_2, \ldots, d_r, 0, \ldots, 0),$
